name: frappe-orchestrator
description: Single-plugin catalogue for this repository, so the orchestrator installs from the working tree rather than a session flag.

plugins.name: frappe-orchestrator
plugins.description: Opus-orchestrated Frappe/ERPNext and Next.js development: OpenCode implements routine work, a Sonnet subagent handles trivial edits and failed OpenCode runs, Codex reviews only risky changes, and a hook enforces Git, site and destructive-operation boundaries with minimal prompts.
